<?php
// Turn the single site into a network of one, in sub-directory mode. The
// Playground enableMultisite step refuses a site address with a port, so the
// network tables are filled here with the core functions that step runs.
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php';

global $wpdb;
foreach ( $wpdb->tables( 'ms_global' ) as $table => $prefixed_table ) {
	$wpdb->$table = $prefixed_table;
}

install_network();

$domain = preg_replace( '|https?://|', '', get_option( 'siteurl' ) );
$slash  = strpos( $domain, '/' );
if ( $slash !== false ) {
	$domain = substr( $domain, 0, $slash );
}

$admin  = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$result = populate_network( 1, $domain, $admin->user_email, 'Panels e2e network', '/', false );
if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
	throw new Exception( implode( ' ', $result->get_error_messages() ) );
}
